## Orange Robot RefMod Creator
**Prepared only. The consistent dataset is not selected yet.**

1. Put 5–8 selected views of the **same robot** in a dedicated folder. Use separate still images, not a labelled contact sheet. Captions are not needed.
2. Replace `SET_CONSISTENT_ROBOT_DATASET_HERE` in node 1 with that folder's path. The loader takes the first eight media files alphabetically; it does not choose the best views.
3. Keep the supplied settings and click **Run**. The placeholder is deliberately not an empty path: empty would load ComfyUI's input folder.

### Output
`models/refmods/lorapilot_orange_robot_consistent_v1.safetensors`

On LoRA Pilot this is normally under `/workspace/`. Change the name before another run if you want to keep both versions; the same name replaces the previous file.

### Use it in a video
Click **Refresh RefMods** in the inference workflow, then select the new file. Multiple photos become one stacked video-kind reference, normally `<Video 1>` when used alone. A single image produces `<Picture 1>`. Check **Reference map** after encoding.

### Settings
Full Reference · 768 px · zero refinement steps · no pooling or merge · one copy · no token truncation. Only the H3 video VAE is needed for creation; no LoRA training or video diffusion runs here.

### Photo consistency
Choose front, three-quarter, side and wider views with matching anatomy and markings. Keep similar aspect ratios and the whole robot inside the frame: this creator crops to the first image's aspect ratio. More images increase inference cost.

[RefMod Pilot setup and guide](https://github.com/vavo/minimax-h3-refmod-pilot)
